name: Reply to Telegram and Slack chats
author: wizard
description: Chats started on Telegram or Slack (or another messaging app connected to your agent) can be continued in WizardOS. Your reply goes through that app's own connection: it shows there marked as from WizardOS, the agent answers in both places, and the conversation and its history stay one. An older chat (before a /new in the app) carries on in WizardOS with a short note in the app. Read by the Agent Service (wizard-agent-service issue 427) and Chats (core/chat-models.js).
